design_system_prompt: BICE - a premium professional Learning Management System (LMS) web application for a data-skills coaching institute offering courses like Advanced Excel Masterclass, Power Query, SQL for Data Analysis, Python for Data Analysis, and Business Dashboards. Overall design language to apply: modern corporate SaaS aesthetic with premium e-learning polish (similar quality to Coursera, Udemy Business, Linear, Stripe dashboards); clean, trustworthy, professional - not playful, no flashy gradients, no oversized elements. Colors: white background, slate-50 (#F8FAFC) section bands, primary color indigo-600 (#4F46E5), deep navy slate-900 (#0F172A) for top navigation, footer and admin sidebar, amber-400 (#FBBF24) accents for star ratings and highlights, green for success states, red for locked/error states. Typography: Inter, bold headings, regular body text, comfortable line heights. Shape: rounded-xl (12px) cards, rounded-lg buttons and inputs, soft subtle shadows, 8px spacing grid, generous whitespace. Components used across the app: sticky navigation bar, primary indigo buttons, outlined secondary buttons, level badges (Beginner green, Intermediate amber, Advanced red), star ratings, progress bars, accordion curriculum sections, clean data tables with status pills, KPI stat cards, skeleton loaders, toast notifications, Lucide-style line icons.
